actual_divisor_API.literal_source:
def fouvryTau (k : ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℕ := ArithmeticFunction.zeta ^ k

@[simp] theorem fouvryTau_zero (k : ℕ) : fouvryTau k 0 = 0 :=
  ArithmeticFunction.map_zero

theorem fouvryTau_multiplicative (k : ℕ) : (fouvryTau k).IsMultiplicative :=
  ArithmeticFunction.isMultiplicative_zeta.pow

@[simp] theorem fouvryTau_one (k : ℕ) : fouvryTau k 1 = 1 :=
  (fouvryTau_multiplicative k).map_one

theorem fouvryTau_order_one {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : fouvryTau 1 n = 1 := by
  simp [fouvryTau, ArithmeticFunction.zeta_apply, hn]

theorem fouvryTau_succ (k n : ℕ) :
    fouvryTau (k + 1) n = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, fouvryTau k d := by
  exact ArithmeticFunction.coe_mul_zeta_apply (f := fouvryTau k)

complete_mathematical_argument: For each original primitive p and every m, labels are exactly cleanedCommonPProgression(p,m) x factorCarrier(Q2) x factorCarrier(Q3), in ordered (n,r,s) coordinates. coeff is the original gamma2(r)*gamma3(s)*cleaned-transposed beta(n) with the physical p*r*s congruence gate; the common-p selector and signed divisor deletion remain.

Generic finite_pair_restore_le uses arbitrary pointwise bounded complex G and an arbitrary decidable keep predicate. Four Boolean cases give norm(term-full minus term-kept) <= |c_i|*badMass_j+badMass_i*|c_j|. Triangle and two finite sums give 2*R*T. There is no Hermitian, positivity, spectral or separability premise on G.

The original ordered absolute factor fiber bound is reused. The b83a nonzero-shift row proof and its slice identity are private, so this small new module reproduces those exact short finite arguments rather than invoking inaccessible private names or inventing a new supplier. The public beta-nonzero version is not wrongly applied to an alpha-transposed row.

For n in the exact cleaned progression, n does not divide the signed residue, hence (m:Integer)*n-residue is nonzero. This is established before divisor membership. The q1 slice is admissible by the existing mediumAdmissible_q1SliceAtom theorem; no transposed admissibility is asserted.

inner_mass_le bounds the sum of absolute coefficients over every ordered (r,s) congruence label by |beta(n)|*tau4(abs(m*n-residue)). This is an absolute sum BEFORE the complex row norm. It does not follow by reversing the existing tailRow_norm_le triangle inequality.

The natural value t=tau4(...) satisfies t<=t^2: t=0 is direct, otherwise t>=1 and a square inequality proves the real inequality. For H<t and H>0, t<=t^2/H. Thus the complete absolute mass R<=rowSum and discarded absolute mass T<=rowSum/H; low t contributes zero to T. Summing over the exact n and ordered physical labels proves absolute_masses_le for all m, without any psi-nonzero restriction.

Apply the generic inequality to these two masses and use nonnegative tail mass and rowSum: norm(W_G-W_G,H)<=2*rowSum^2/H. Multiply the unchanged nonnegative original psi, sum on the unchanged primitive p and complete common smoothing m carrier, and multiply the original outsideEnergy>=0 once. The finite moment definition and scalar algebra produce exactly 2*outsideEnergy*moment/H.
